You have a chance to receive prizes such as Key Cards or Chronos Stones, and you will also receive a stamp in your Scratchbook for finding a cat.
Collect Scratchbook stamps to earn Majestic Furballs, which can be traded in the Cats' Saucer for gear with special Abilities.

Your Scratchbook will level up based on factors like finding cats on Scratchbook trips, as well as Main Story progress.
A higher-level Scratchbook means cats can visit more places, gives you more cats to look for daily, and will raise the weekly cap on stamps you can receive.

[h3]New System: Phase Amplifier[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39936083/3a534159792710eee9cadc139f07351d3988bb72.png[/img]

This system is a new way to boost EXP gained within Phase Shifts, a special environmental effect that can occur on some fields after Chapter 85 (Main Story Part 3 Volume 1).

A Phase Crystal is required to activate the Phase Amplifier's effects in a Phase Shift.
When you leave a Phase Shift, there is a set chance that the Phase Amplifier's boost effect will end.
However, if the effect does not end, the Phase Amplifier field will rank up, increasing the EXP boost amount further.
The field can rank up two times maximum.
Phase Crystals can be found rarely within Phase Shifts, but the number you can obtain daily is limited. (Max 3)
Main story chapter 92 (Part 3 Volume 1) must be cleared.
*Please note that Phase Crystals cannot be found while the Phase Amplifier is active
*The limit on Phase Crystals obtainable resets daily
*The obtainable Phase Crystal limit resets based on the timing of the Lynx delivery
*The daily limit on obtainable Phase Crystals may be adjusted during campaigns, etc.
*A feature that prevents the Phase Amplifier from shutting down (once per day) is planned to be added to the "Guide of the Heavens" service after an update scheduled for May 2024.

　*We have confirmed that all skills aside from the normal attack variation "Shatterglass" have been corrected

[h3]Fixed the following issues[/h3]
・In battle with a certain boss in the Astral Archive, when a battle mechanic activates under specific conditions, it may become impossible to progress.

・When using skills that grant Barrier Pierce in succession, the Barrier Pierce effect may apply 1 time fewer than intended
　・Sazanca: Intensive Research
　・Ewella Another Style (Oberon): Reflexio
・When attacking after using a skill or ability that applies Barrier Pierce, the Barrier Pierce effect may not be properly consumed
・When upgrading the below Grastas with Dormant Ore, the display may not change
　・Resonant Power (Shadow)
　・Power of Offense (C)/(T)/(S)
　*This only affects the display. We have confirmed that the effect applies properly to the whole party.
・When playing an Another Dungeon, if EXP Items or Grasta Alchemic Ores claimed at one time surpass 999, the app may forcibly close when logging in after app restart.
・Text and display issues.
・Other small bugs

[h3]The 7th Character Popularity Vote is ongoing![/h3]
The 7th anniversary of Another Eden: The Cat Beyond Time and Space is coming up on April 12, 2024.
We're seven years strong thanks to all of you, and we'll keep on working

Cat Express Tickets
Cat Express Tickets can be spent when challenging a previously cleared Another Dungeon, along with the normal Key Card cost, to skip to the Clear screen.
You will receive normal clear rewards, as well as loot from dungeon treasure chests and enemy materials.
If you use a Cat Express Ticket on a Dungeon that can raise Light/Shadow Points, you will receive Light/Shadow Points normally.
If you have defeated the relevant Horror(s) at least once, you can also receive Horror item drops when skipping.

A set amount of Cat Express Tickets may be obtained monthly from Guide of the Heavens and Guide of the Land. They may also be distributed in campaigns, events, or via other means.

*By using a Cat Express Ticket, you will not receive EXP or Git from winning battles, or certain limited items.
*For items that drop from enemies that respawn continually, you will receive an amount within a fixed range.
*Some Dungeons allow you to choose your route. After defeating the bosses that appear at the end of those routes and clearing, you will be able to skip those routes.
*Routes that require items or certain conditions to be met to proceed are not eligible for the Skip function.
*For Episodes, etc., that give Key Item collection bonuses to certain characters when in the party, these bonuses will not activate when using the Skip function.
*The list of Dungeons eligible for Cat Express Tickets is planned to be expanded in the future.

[h3]The following functions will be added[/h3]
New benefits will be added to "Guide of the Heavens" and "Guide of the Land" after the Ver 3.5.10 update.
・While subscribed to the Guide of the Heavens, the amount of Tsubura's Gems you can obtain per week will be boosted from 120 to 180 per week.
・While subscribed to the Guide of the Land, the amount of Tsubura's Gems you obtain per Another Dungeon clear will be boosted from 10 to 15 per clear.
・Cat Express Ticket Restock Feature added

By subscribing to Guide of the Heavens or Guide of the Land, you will be able to Restock a full complement of Cat Express Tickets (50 tickets).
Cat Express Ticket Restock can be used when the number of tickets in your possession is lower than your maximum.
While subscribed to Guide of the Heavens, you may perform 5 Cat Express Ticket Restocks per month. While subscribed to Guide of the Land, you may perform 1 Cat Express Ticket Restock per month.
*The number of Cat Express Ticket Restocks the subscriber can perform are valid for one month from the date of subscription. Remaining restocks will be reset when the subscription is renewed.
*The Cat Express Tickets you have obtained from Restocks will not vanish when your Cat Express Ticket Restock count is reset.
*Cat Express Tickets may also be distributed in campaigns or via other means.

Another Eden's Global Version will finally catch up to simultaneous release with the Japan Version this month.

notes.title: [Resolved] Forced App Closure While Playing Apocrypha: The Road to Thunder
notes.notes:
We have confirmed that certain users of the Steam version may experience a forced app closure while playing the in-app movie in Apocrypha: The Road to Thunder.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

We have released a new version that resolves this issue.

Please update your game version from your Steam library.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Regarding "wfsdrv"
notes.notes:
We have been recently made aware about concerns users are having with the "wfsdrv" program that is installed along with the Steam version of Another Eden.

We take information privacy seriously at WFS and would like to alleviate any fears our users might have about the security of the recently released Steam version of Another Eden.

The program in wfsdrv is an anti-cheat kernel driver, and is installed to protect the integrity of the Another Eden experience so that all players are able to operate in a fair play-environment.

This program was also reviewed by Valve and passed Steam review, and is not made to maliciously affect the end-user's computer or data.

The wfsdrv program is removed when Another Eden is uninstalled.

We would like to thank you for your continued patience and support, and hope you continue to support WFS, and Another Eden in the future.

-The Another Eden Team
